suite.name: vesselnav-bench
suite.description: Seeded navigation suite for comparing autonomous-vessel navigation policies under identical physics, scenarios, and scoring: canonical COLREGs encounters, coastal planning, and randomized worlds, in calm and disturbed (current + wind gust) conditions.

about.author: V. Ravendranathan (VesselNav-Bench baseline)
about.summary: PPO policy over a labeled 35-feature observation (goal vector, own dynamics, land lidar, nearest traffic); each decision logs the full action probability distribution and value estimate.
